description: Switch between projects in a flash, PhpStorm style: recent, favorite and auto-detected projects in a searchable list.
config.openInNewWindow: Open projects in a new window (a new tab when `#window.nativeTabs#` is enabled on macOS). The button on each row does the opposite.
config.reuseEmptyWindow: Open the project in the current window when no folder is open in it.
config.pathDisplay: Information shown next to the project name.
config.pathDisplay.parentPath: Parent folder path, next to the name
config.pathDisplay.parentPathBelow: Parent folder path, below the name
config.pathDisplay.parentName: Parent folder name only, next to the name
config.pathDisplay.parentNameBelow: Parent folder name only, below the name
config.recentLimit: Number of projects shown in the "Recent" section. The others remain in the list and in the search.
config.scanFolders: Folders to search for projects (e.g. `~/Projects`). A folder is a project when it contains one of the `#projectSwitcher.scanMarkers#`.
config.scanDepth: How deep to search for projects under each folder of projectSwitcher.scanFolders.
config.scanMarkers: Files or folders that identify a project.
config.showOtherProjects: Show the "Other Projects" section (auto-detected projects and older recent ones) when the search field is empty. They always appear as soon as you type a search.
config.showInStatusBar: Show the current project on the left of the status bar (click to switch project).
config.showInEditorTitle: Show a "Switch Project" button in the editor tab bar.
